prompt: Как называется деталь с внутренней резьбой, которую навинчивают на болт?
note: Заклёпки устанавливают постоянно; для удаления обычно приходится высверливать крепёж.
answerGrammar: All four answer labels are nominative noun phrases answering Как называется деталь or Какой крепёж; no gender/case or sentence-completion cue excludes a distractor.
plausibilityAndKeyGrounds: Rivet is a real neighbouring fastener and plausible to a novice, but its body is set by deformation rather than screwed onto a bolt using a female thread.
noteGrammar: Complete natural two-clause Russian sentence; крепёж refers to the rivet being removed.
allNoteClaims: RP p.30 explicitly treats rivets as permanent fasteners and drilling as removal. The Russian usually is weaker than the manual categorical wording and does not claim drilling is the only conceivable operation.
individualUsefulness: Adds the practical cost of dismantling: drilling out the fastener; this is absent from the head-forming question and is more than a reworded definition.

sources.context: Rivets: permanent installation and drilling removal; Solid rivets shop head, Table IX including reference 21 and Briles footnote 13.

prompt: Как называется деталь с внутренней резьбой, которую навинчивают на болт?
note: Большинство болтов изготавливают из углеродистой, легированной или нержавеющей стали.
answerGrammar: All four answer labels are nominative noun phrases answering Как называется деталь or Какой крепёж; no gender/case or sentence-completion cue excludes a distractor.
plausibilityAndKeyGrounds: Bolt is a plausible paired component familiar from гайка и болт, but its outer thread is the received member, not the internally threaded receiving part.
noteGrammar: Three parallel material adjectives share стали; изготавливают из is idiomatic.
allNoteClaims: RP p.5 explicitly says most bolts are carbon, alloy or stainless steel. Большинство preserves the qualifier and allows titanium/aluminium exceptions; the card makes no unsupported strength/corrosion claim.
individualUsefulness: Adds material selection information rather than repeating the question or an external-thread definition.

sources.context: Fastener Materials, first paragraph; page read through Cadmium Plating and numbered precautions.

prompt: Как называется деталь с внутренней резьбой, которую навинчивают на болт?
note: Нейлоновый вкладыш выступает в резьбу; сопряжённая резьба сжимает его и создаёт стопорящий контакт.
answerGrammar: All four answer labels are nominative noun phrases answering Как называется деталь or Какой крепёж; no gender/case or sentence-completion cue excludes a distractor.
plausibilityAndKeyGrounds: Nut alone has the female threaded receiving body in the described bolt joint; key 2 remains unique.
noteGrammar: Two technical but complete clauses; сопряжённая резьба сжимает его clearly refers to the insert. No grammatical implication of universal possession.
allNoteClaims: RP p.11 Nylok paragraph and fig.4 support projection, mating-thread compression and locking contact. This is a statement about a named nylon insert, not an assertion that every nut contains it. Nut-card explanation explicitly says Некоторые гайки; rivet-card note likewise has no universal quantifier. More explicit subtype wording would improve standalone clarity but the actual sentence does not claim all nuts have nylon.
individualUsefulness: Explains how one locking element works, beyond the internal-thread definition; a player learns a real mechanical effect.
correctNoteBeyondPrompt: Explains how one locking element works, beyond the internal-thread definition; a player learns a real mechanical effect.
